channel.title: RavenFabric Blog
channel.description: Engineering blog — deep dives into security, cryptography, networking, and distributed systems.

item.title: Demo 1: Multi-Node Ubuntu — 17 Scenarios, Two Agents, Zero Trust
item.description: Run 17 scenarios on two Ubuntu agents in Docker — remote execution, port forwarding, policy denial, audit trails, fleet orchestration, and human approval for AI agents. Everything SSH, Ansible, and Tailscale do, in one binary.

item.title: How RavenFabric Stops AI Agents from Running rm -rf /
item.description: Deny-by-default policy enforcement for autonomous AI execution. Two independent checks, shell injection prevention, behavioral anomaly detection, and immutable audit trails — because "are you sure?" doesn't work for machines.

item.title: Zero-Trust Mesh Networking Without Certificates
item.description: Deep dive into the Noise XX handshake — mutual authentication, identity hiding, forward secrecy, relay opacity, and post-quantum readiness. How RavenFabric builds a mesh network without a single certificate.

item.title: Why Noise XX over TLS
item.description: Why RavenFabric chose the Noise XX handshake pattern instead of TLS. Mutual authentication, identity hiding, no certificate authorities, and relay opacity — all from a single protocol.
